header.purpose: NACA Report 1377 tapered blade, NACA four-digit sections (primary); Phase 156b, case R1377_FLIGHT; ISSUE-048 ground-test diagnostic: plus the ground-row grid points
header.grid_rule: each section on the grid points bracketing its kinematic range on the 39 rows
header.alpha_grid_deg: -6 to 20, 0.5 step (up and down sweeps from 0); fill pass for hung sweeps
header.ground_grid_rule: grid points bracketing each station's range on the 28 ground rows with a printed level (no induction), not already in the flight set
